name: cavemio-drop-zone-membrane
title: Drop Zone Membrane
description: A responsive membrane drop zone with shadcn attachments, upload progress, processing, retry and cancellation.

cavemio.usage:
import { DropZoneMembrane } from "@/components/drop-zone-membrane";

<DropZoneMembrane accept="image/*,.pdf" maxSize={10_000_000} maxFiles={2} onFilesChange={setFiles} onUpload={uploadFile} />
cavemio.accessibility: Native button supports Enter and Space to browse, and focused paste. File updates are announced politely; progress bars are labelled; retry and remove actions name their file. Files appear directly as attachment cards. Reduced motion disables membrane bending, card entry motion and shimmer. Attachment icons and labels animate within a persistent card, and reduced motion uses immediate state changes. Upload and retry actions transfer focus to the stable remove button.
cavemio.previewNote: The preview simulates upload progress locally; supply onUpload for a real service. Without it, selected files remain ready to upload.

props.name: onUpload
props.description: Optional. Uploads one file: report progress, honour the signal, resolve when done or throw to show an error with Retry.

props.name: autoUpload
props.description: Optional. Start uploads on selection. False exposes an Upload action on each ready file.

props.name: onFilesChange
props.description: Optional. The files currently in the list, after every add and remove.

props.name: accept
props.description: Optional. Like an input's accept: MIME types, wildcards and extensions, e.g. "image/*,.pdf".

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Optional. Maximum number of files accepted in the list.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Optional. One file at a time: a new drop replaces it.

props.name: hint
props.description: Optional. File requirements in the tray footer, e.g. "PNG, JPG or PDF, up to 10 MB".

props.name: ref
props.description: Optional. Ref exposing the file-picker controls.
